{{Quote|It sees.|Nerrethel's last notes|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Nerrethel''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> Sometime between [[3645 BBY]] and [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Nerrethel grew interested in the structure known as the [[Dark Heart]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], and spent two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] studying the structure, comparing its architecture to that of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and analyzing the Dark Heart's orientation relative to Voss's constellations. However, when he attempted to visit the Dark Heart in person, Nerrethel was found dead on the border of the surrounding region known as the [[Nightmare Lands]]. His only notes from the expedition were the words "It sees"&mdash;for he had encountered the entity [[Sel-Makor]] within the Dark Heart.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nerrethel was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Dark Heart in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
